name: Afghanistan
headline: Afghanistan: +1.5% growth in 2025, 3.6% inflation, debt 8% of GDP
sections: Afghanistan is a $19.7 billion economy (2025), the world's 137th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +1.5% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $2,236 at purchasing-power parity (2024), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 8.4% of GDP (2024).

Consumer prices rose 3.6% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 10.6% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 13.4% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 16.8% (2025).
Gross government debt is 8% of GDP (2025), a low level. The general government balance is −0.5% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −37.9% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 84% of GDP (2024), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 0.1% of GDP (2021).
Life expectancy is 66.3 years (2024). Population: 43.8 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
